label: Universal brand core
description: Asked of every brand regardless of industry. Industry templates add to this, never replace it.

questions.help: Exactly as it should appear in an ad — including capitalisation.

questions.prompt: What do you sell, in one or two sentences?
questions.help: Plain language. What someone gets, and why it is worth paying for.
The more specific the better — 'facilities managers at mid-size warehouses' beats 'businesses'.
Pick the closest, then refine in the next question.

questions.prompt: Anything about the voice we should know?
questions.help: Words you always use, words you never use, how formal, whether humour is welcome.

questions.prompt: What does the brand stand for?
questions.help: Three to five. These shape which arguments the system is willing to make.
Add each colour with a name. Used in generated imagery.
Display face for headings, body face for everything else.
Added on top of whatever your industry's compliance rules already forbid.

questions.prompt: Text that must appear in every ad
questions.help: Leave empty unless legal or a regulator requires it.
Used to avoid accidentally echoing their positioning.
